dedupe_keys.name: k water dam and weir hydrological operation data water level inflow release storage and k water open data portal

description: K-water publishes hydrological operation data for the dams and weirs it manages on Korea's public data portal: dam water level, rainfall, inflow, total release, storage and storage rate at 61 sites (21 multipurpose dams, 14 water supply dams, the Nakdong estuary barrage, 3 flood control dams, 6 regulating reservoirs and 16 weirs), at 10-minute, hourly and daily steps from January 2006, with the period differing by site. K-water produced the data, which is offered as a yearly CSV file and as an open REST API (XML and JSON) with automatic approval of an API key; the portal states it is free with no restriction on the scope of use. K-water's own open data portal lists 413 datasets on water resources, water supply, sewerage, water quality and drought, among them the specifications of flood control dams and an integrated table of water treatment plants with location, capacity and supply area. Coverage is the dams and weirs operated by K-water in South Korea. Caveats: the file holds the latest 10,000 records, blanks occur where data were not aggregated, and water levels of all dams nationwide are published separately by the Han River Flood Control Office. Simulation uses: reservoir operation, inflow and release series for capacity planning and flood and drought response studies of dams and water supply. Related records: the Global Dam Watch database (data-global-dam-watch-database) and GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database).
